acceptedAnswer.text: PiDude Web Inspector is a free, open-source (MIT) extension for the Pi coding agent. It lets developers select an element in a local web preview and insert an @element_N reference into their prompt, so the AI agent receives precise visual context — selector, tag, text, accessibility labels, and page path — instead of a vague description.

mainEntity.name: How do I reference a UI element to an AI coding agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Run /preview http://localhost:5173 in Pi, switch the picker to Select, click the element, then choose Insert into Pi. The reference lands at your editor cursor; when you send the prompt, the agent receives the element's metadata as focused context.

It captures only the selected element's metadata and sends it to your configured model when you submit a referenced prompt. It never captures form values, cookies, storage, full-page HTML, or URL query strings, and it only opens localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1] previews in a separate, temporary browser profile.
Yes — MIT-licensed open source, built at PiDude (pidude.dev).
